claim_origin_contract.origin_group_scope: one factual publication chain, not provider company count

invariants: source-published timestamp is not automatically platform availability
correction creates revision and invalidates downstream dependencies
unresolved original publisher cannot be counted as confirmed independent origin
engagement belongs to sampled_at, not automatically post creation time
absent participant counts stay null
default processing is read_only
store minimal author identity only
gross turnover does not imply net flow
different methodology is a different series
quarterly reporting period and publication date remain distinct
unknown zero and true zero remain different
source cadence conflict must remain explicit
rank change is not a return estimate
cross-platform levels are not directly additive
same seat can occur on both buy and sell side
overlapping one-day and multi-day reports cannot be naively added
generic institution numbered labels are report-local unless stable ID is verified
report cannot affect decisions before available_at
missing methodology excludes statistic from certified tradable benchmark
branch statistics are not beneficial-owner identity
historical decision uses historically known membership
industry taxonomy and provider concept are separate namespaces
membership changes append revisions

special_requirements: explicit raw and adjusted price basis

rules: HTTP 200 does not imply valid data; reject login/captcha/truncated or changed schema payloads.
success_empty and not_modified update contact health without pretending new data arrived.
Market data can be not_expected outside its calendar; news remains 24x7.
Advance committed cursor only after durable raw commit and outbox creation.
Maximum event time is not a completeness watermark.
Replay uses overlap and revision channels; late corrections are not filtered solely by latest timestamp.
An independent watchdog checks worker heartbeat and dataset progress.
Rate limits cause bounded backoff and do not advance the cursor.
Health is per endpoint/dataset/partition, not merely a reachable provider homepage.

quality_checks.check: raw payload is expected document type, not login/error shell
required fields, native type, unit and timestamp precision match mapping version
quality_checks.failure: invalid or partial; no canonical publication if essential field fails

quality_checks.check: raw amount unit and canonical CNY conversion are explicit
pagination and contiguous cursor gaps reconciled
quality_checks.failure: partial coverage, do not label complete

quality_checks.check: original article IDs and revision hashes deduplicate push/poll/backfill
claim independence resolved separately from media copies
quality_checks.failure: unknown origin, no independent confirmation increment

quality_checks.check: funding metric provider/method/window/session equal before comparison
available_at bounds historical feature use and engagement snapshots
source reports no records only after valid response and complete page checks
unresolved seat and concept entities are nullable and auditable
quality_checks.failure: hold entity linking, do not fabricate ID

quality_checks.check: ranking release has consistent snapshot/horizon/target/membership version
